text: My son is 2, temp 38. He just will NOT settle tonight, keeps getting up and crying, though in the daytime he was fine. He hasn't done a poo in 3 days and he's grumpy, holding his tummy a bit. I keep checking him and his colour's normal, lips pink, nothing weird, and he hasn't had any fit or shaking or anything like that. I'm scared I'm missing something. Is this just the constipation keeping him up?
